product.name: Monoprice 13-in-1 Dual-HDMI + DisplayPort Multi-Stream Transport (MST) Dock
product.description: Monoprice™13‑in‑1 Triple Display Docking StationDual 4K HDMI, 4K DisplayPort, 5Gbps USB‑A, Gigabit Ethernet, SD/MicroSD Readers, 100W PD Passthrough Charging, 3.5mm Dual Audio/Microphone Jack Charging, 3.5mm Dual Audio/Microphone JackThe Monoprice™ 13‑in‑1 Dual‑HDMI + DisplayPort Universal Triple Display Dock is an exceptional docking solution designed to enhance productivity and streamline your workplace setup. This compact yet powerful device transforms a single USB‑C (with DP1.4 or DP1.2 mode) or Thunderbolt port into a comprehensive array of 13 ports, offering unparalleled connectivity options.With the Monoprice™ 13‑in‑1 Dock, you can effortlessly connect multiple external displays, thanks to its support for triple monitor setups. The dock features two 4K HDMI ports and one 4K DisplayPort, enabling you to enjoy stunning high‑resolution visuals and immerse yourself in your work or entertainment content.In addition to its impressive display capabilities, this docking station provides an abundance of USB connectivity. It boasts five high‑speed USB‑A data ports, allowing you to connect various peripheral devices such as a mouse, keyboard, headset, storage drives, and more. The USB‑A ports support data transfer rates of up to 5Gbps, ensuring swift and efficient file transfers.One standout feature of the Monoprice™ 13‑in‑1 Dock is its USB‑C port, which supports fast 100W Power Delivery pass‑through charging. This means that while you're using the dock to connect and power your peripherals, you can simultaneously charge your laptop at an impressive speed, eliminating the need for additional chargers or cables.Setting up the Monoprice™ 13‑in‑1 Dock is incredibly easy, as it offers true plug‑and‑play functionality. There are no complicated drivers or special software required for installation. Simply connect the dock to your compatible Windows or MacOS system, and it's ready to use.Speaking of compatibility, this versatile dock supports both MST (Multi‑Stream Transport) and SST (Single‑Stream Transport) modes on Windows systems, offering flexibility for multi‑monitor configurations. On MacOS, it supports SST modes, allowing you to enjoy the benefits of extended displays seamlessly.Whether you're a professional seeking a powerful docking solution for your workspace or a content creator in need of expanded display capabilities, the Monoprice™ 13‑in‑1 Dual‑HDMI + DisplayPort Universal Triple Display Dock delivers exceptional performance, effortless connectivity, and unparalleled convenience.
